Get KZS Player Box Score

Source: R/kzs.R
kzs_box_score.Rd

Box score of a final game (2015/16 on): one row per player of both teams.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/matches/{match_id}/stats

Usage

kzs_box_score(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(required) Match id (match_id in kzs_matches), e.g. 101839. Global across seasons.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Box score of a final game (2015/16 on): one row per player of both teams. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py kzs_box_score):

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerMatch id: the federation key of a game, global across seasons (joins kzs_matches and kzs_match).
team_sidecharacterWhich side of the match the row belongs to: home (the organiser, firstTeam on the wire) or away.
team_idintegerTeam id: one club team in one season (joins kzs_teams); not the match-team id and not the club id.
team_namecharacterName of the team for the season, sponsor included.
minutesdoubleThe player's minutes played, decimal minutes (39.67 = 39 min 40 s); the team line sums its players (225.0 = 5 x 45 with overtime).
two_pmintegerThe player's two-point field goals made.
two_paintegerThe player's two-point field goals attempted.
two_p_percdoubleThe player's two-point percentage, 0-100.
three_pmintegerThe player's three-point field goals made.
three_paintegerThe player's three-point field goals attempted.
three_p_percdoubleThe player's three-point percentage, 0-100.
f_tmintegerThe player's free throws made.
f_taintegerThe player's free throws attempted.
f_t_percdoubleThe player's free-throw percentage, 0-100.
fg_mintegerThe player's field goals made.
fg_aintegerThe player's field goals attempted.
fg_percdoubleThe player's field-goal percentage, 0-100.
offensive_reboundsintegerThe player's offensive rebounds.
defensive_reboundsintegerThe player's defensive rebounds.
total_reboundsintegerThe player's total rebounds.
assistsintegerThe player's assists.
stealsintegerThe player's steals.
turnoversintegerThe player's turnovers.
blocks_in_favorintegerThe player's shots blocked (blocks made).
blocks_againstintegerThe player's own shots that were blocked.
foul_commitedintegerThe player's fouls committed.
foul_receivedintegerThe player's fouls drawn.
p_irintegerThe player's PIR, performance index rating ((points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks + fouls drawn) - (missed field goals + missed free throws + turnovers + shots blocked + fouls committed)).
plus_minusintegerThe player's plus-minus: points scored minus allowed while on court (team line: the final margin).
assists_turnover_ratiodoubleThe player's assist-to-turnover ratio (0 in every sample: not computed).
defensive_ratingdoubleThe player's defensive rating (0 in every sample: not computed).
efficiencyintegerThe player's efficiency as the feed computes it (equal to pIR on 2025-26 team lines).
pointsintegerThe player's points.
efficiency_customdoubleThe player's custom efficiency as the federation computes it (equal to efficiency on player rows; 0 on team lines).
efficiency_game_scoredoubleThe player's game score (0 in every sample: not computed).
fast_break_points_attemptedintegerThe player's fast-break attempts (0 in every sample: not computed).
fast_break_points_madeintegerThe player's fast-break makes (0 in every sample: not computed).
usage_percentagedoubleThe player's usage percentage (0 in every sample: not computed).
m_vp_votesintegerThe player's MVP votes (0 in every sample).
minusintegerThe player's points allowed on court (0 in every sample: not computed).
offensive_ratingdoubleThe player's offensive rating (0 in every sample: not computed).
p_erdoubleThe player's PER (0 in every sample: not computed).
plusintegerThe player's points scored on court (0 in every sample: not computed).
points_fast_breakintegerThe player's fast-break points.
points_in_the_paintintegerThe player's points in the paint.
points_in_the_paint_attemptedintegerThe player's paint attempts (0 in every sample: not computed).
points_in_the_paint_madeintegerThe player's paint makes (0 in every sample: not computed).
points_second_chanceintegerThe player's second-chance points.
second_chance_points_attemptedintegerThe player's second-chance attempts (0 in every sample: not computed).
second_chance_points_madeintegerThe player's second-chance makes (0 in every sample: not computed).
true_shooting_attemptsintegerThe player's true-shooting attempts (0 in every sample: not computed).
true_shooting_percentagedoubleThe player's true-shooting percentage (0 in every sample: not computed).
player_idintegerPlayer id (KZS player registry). Joins to /players/{playerId}, box-score and play-by-play playerId.
photo_uuidcharacterPlayer photo: image file id, served at https://api.kzs.si/public/images/{uuid}.
match_team_player_firstnamecharacterThe player's given name, as entered for this match (lower-case n in this route).
match_team_player_lastnamecharacterThe player's family name, as entered for this match (lower-case n in this route).
match_team_player_year_of_birthcharacterBirth year from the match entry, sent as a string ('2002'); the profile person.yearOfBirth is an integer.
jersey_numbercharacterShirt number worn, sent as a string ('1', '55').
starting_lineuplogicalTrue when the player started.
captainlogicalGames as captain.
playedlogicalTrue when the player got on court.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the public read API (Java/Spring, built by OnixWeb) that the kzs.si site itself calls. No terms of use were located (unverified), api.kzs.si/robots.txt answers 401 and www.kzs.si/robots.txt 404, so no policy or Crawl-delay is published. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Personal data: the API serves officials' and coaches' emails, phones and home towns, and clubs' bank accounts and addresses, publicly. The parsers never output them (officials appear by name only; club addresses, personnel and the commissioner report are dropped). Do not add them back.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/2027); KZS' own season ids are opaque (27 = 2026/2027) and the runtime maps them. Competition ids are per season. Three team keys are never interchangeable: the match-team id (per match and side), team_id (one club team in one season) and club_id (across seasons). player_id is the registry id, person_id the person behind it.

  • Errors are HTTP 400 for everything (an unknown id and a bad parameter alike), so the runtime raises hoopR_asset_fetch for it, never hoopR_bad_request or an empty frame. List routes default to 150 rows with no truncation signal: every list wrapper asks for a large limit and refuses a full page. The play-by-play and box-score wrappers, the leaderboards, teams, rounds and playing days each make one extra, cached request (the match header or the competition) to prove the answer is the one asked for and the game is final.

  • Coverage: scores from 2007/08; box scores and play-by-play from 2015/16. Some 2020/21 men's games have a box score but no play-by-play (hoopR_no_data): the Genius data.json (genius_match_id in kzs_matches) is the fallback. Shot x/y are Genius court percent; side (LEFT/RIGHT) names the basket end and teams switch ends at half time, so normalise with side before stacking shots. Advanced box-score fields are 0 in every observed game.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (an empty answer or list, a competition without standings, a final game with no play-by-play or box score, HTTP 404), hoopR_asset_fetch (HTTP 400, the API's only error status for an unknown id and a bad parameter alike; any other non-2xx; a non-JSON or empty body; an envelope whose status is not OK; a full list page; a game that is not final; a body for another competition, match, team, player or season than the one asked for) and hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, before any request). HTTP 500 is retried. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame for a failed fetch.
